summary: Use Home Assistant WebSocket notification delivery and show unseen tab activity.
features: Show an orange dot when content changes inside a tab that is not currently being viewed.
Clear the unseen-change indicator when the affected tab is opened.
Support indicators on primary navigation, Plugins, Automations, Notifications, and Settings subtabs.
Detect new autonomous notification activity while another tab is open.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
fixes: Send Notification Center and Watchlist messages through Home Assistant's WebSocket service-call path.
Eliminate false HTTP 500 delivery failures returned after Telegram already accepted a notification.
Avoid REST fallback retries that could duplicate an already delivered Telegram message.
Preserve the exact Telegram payload and Delivery Log controls introduced in v0.12.47.
validation: Home Assistant WebSocket notification transport and REST exclusion coverage
Primary and nested unseen-tab indicator coverage
Lightweight autonomous notification activity detection coverage
Release and Workshop Memory synchronization metadata validation
